entry.title: New: Bill 22 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AMENDS CHAPTER 25, ARTICLE 5, OF THE HAWAI‘I COUNTY CODE 1983 (2016 EDITION, AS AMENDED), RELATING TO HOSPITALS, SANITARIUMS, OLD AGE, CONVALESCENT, NURSING AND REST HOMES

Adds hospitals, sanitariums, old age, convalescent, nursing and rest homes as permitted uses in the Industrial-Commercial Mixed Zoning District.

Latest action: Council: Bill 22 passes second & final reading - 2/19/25
